decks.notes: The deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal and disruptive creatures. The key idea is to put pressure on the opponent's resources while utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Aether Vial to slow down their development. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for powerful equipment, the deck aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually generating card advantage with Recruiter of the Guard and Stoneforge Mystic. Aether Vial is used to cheat out creatures and control the board, while cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude provide removal options. The deck also leverages Karakas and Wasteland to disrupt powerful opposing creatures, creating a proactive game plan that aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of disruption and aggression.

This deck aims to quickly and efficiently put powerful creatures into play from the graveyard, using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave to cheat them onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Unmask and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By leveraging powerful reanimation spells and a mix of combo pieces, the deck can win the game in just a few turns by overwhelming the opponent with large and difficult-to-deal-with creatures.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering important spells, removing threats from the board, and digging for answers with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. Lórien Revealed and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and selection, while Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler serve as win conditions. Additionally, the deck utilizes lands like Wasteland and Karakas to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the Aluren combo, which allows you to play all creatures in your deck for free. The deck uses cards like Show and Tell and Acererak the Archlich to quickly bring out key pieces like Omniscience and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. This allows you to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and spells, while also using counters like Force of Will to protect your combo. Additionally, cards like Stock Up and Brainstorm help to filter through your deck and find the pieces you need to win.

This BUG Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while efficiently drawing cards and generating value. It uses a variety of removal spells and hand disruption to control the board, while also having powerful threats like Uro and Kaito to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. With a flexible mana base and a mix of control elements, threats, and card draw, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a slower, more grindy matchup.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with disruption from Thoughtseize, Swords to Plowshares, and Cabal Therapy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls while controlling the board with Goblin Bombardment. The land base includes fetch lands like Marsh Flats and Arid Mesa to ensure mana consistency, along with utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around quickly building a strong board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering and removing opponent's threats while using powerful card draw and selection to find key pieces. The deck utilizes a combination of counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Snare, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler to generate card advantage and provide additional control elements. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through efficient control tactics.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish control of the board through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also utilizing powerful tempo plays like Daze and Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Moonshadow, while also having efficient removal in Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with any threats. The mana base is optimized to support the Dimir color combination and provide flexibility in casting spells. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining tempo and controlling the game until victory is achieved.

The deck focuses on quickly getting big creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them for a powerful board presence. It uses cards like Faithless Looting, Thoughtseize, and Cabal Therapy to fill the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to bring out creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also has some disruptive elements like Unmask and Undercity Sewers to control the game and protect its combo pieces.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Simian Spirit Guide, Eye of Ugin, Eldrazi Temple, and Lotus Petal in order to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer early in the game. Additionally, disruption is key with cards like Chalice of the Void, Thorn of Amethyst, and Wasteland to slow down the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board with disruptive spells to secure a victory through early game pressure.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful lands like Cloudpost and Tron to ramp up quickly and control the game. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Karn, the Great Creator while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor. The deck is designed to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of powerful spells and mana acceleration, ultimately leading to a dominating position on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple help ramp into bigger threats like Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End. Chalice of the Void and Eldrazi Confluence disrupt the opponent's game plan while Glaring Fleshraker and Sire of Seven Deaths provide additional threats. The deck is designed to create a fast and intense gameplay experience focused on quickly closing out the game with overwhelming Eldrazi creatures.

This Doomsday combo deck aims to set up a winning combination by using cards like Dark Ritual, Doomsday, and Thassa's Oracle to win the game in a single turn. The deck includes a mix of control elements like Force of Will and disruption cards like Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help assemble the combo pieces quickly. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around efficiently setting up and executing the Doomsday combo to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggro strategy. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Opal provide strong synergy with artifacts. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to control the board. Urza's Saga is a key card for generating additional artifact tokens and ramping up mana. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure with efficient artifact creatures and powerful artifacts.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and counter spells while deploying efficient threats and controlling the board state. By combining aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and secure victory through calculated plays and resource management. Additionally, cards like Fatal Push and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide additional removal and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent.
